title: Install
description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product in release, removes the copy SwiftPM's install folder holds through experimental-uninstall, and installs the build through experimental-install

package.description: Package folder the plugin infers, passed as --package-path

product.description: Executable product the plugin infers from swift package describe

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to the release build and placed ahead of experimental-install, whose own build then takes the same options
